camel_example: aliyun servicecatalog DisassociatePrincipalFromPortfolio --region cn-hangzhou --PortfolioId 'port-bp1yt7582g****' --PrincipalType RamUser --version 2021-09-01 --method POST --force
name: DisassociatePrincipalFromPortfolio

parameters.help_en:
The RAM entity type. Valid values:

RamUser: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
RamRole: RAM role
parameters.help_zh:
RAM实体类型。取值：

RamUser：RAM用户。
RamRole：RAM角色
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en:
The RAM entity ID.

For the method to obtain the ID of a Resource Access Management (RAM) user, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28681.html.

For the method to obtain the ID of a RAM role, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.help_zh:
RAM实体ID。

获取RAM用户ID的方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28681.html。

获取RAM角色ID的方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.name: principal_id

parameters.help_en: The RAM entity name rule. This parameter takes effect when PrincipalType is set to RamPattern. To configure a name rule for RAM users, use the format user/${userName}. To configure a name rule for RAM roles, use the format role/${roleName}
parameters.help_zh: RAM实体名称规则，当PrincipalType填写RamPattern时生效。如需配置Ram用户名称规则，格式为user/${userName}；如需配置Ram角色名称规则，格式为role/${roleName}
parameters.name: principal_pattern
